column1: # Covers: Colombian-origin / Colombian-headquartered brands: coffee, beer, aguardiente and rum, soft drinks,
# packaged food, snacks and candy (Nutresa, Colombina, Quala, Ramo, Super ...), dairy, restaurant chains,
# retailers, supermarkets and shopping centres, banks, fintech, payments and apps, insurance and pension funds,
# lotteries and betting, energy and utilities, conglomerates, construction and industrial companies, airlines and
# transport (including city mass-transit systems), media, newspapers and radio, fashion, designers, underwear,
# shapewear and swimwear, footwear, cosmetics, personal care and pharma, appliances and motorcycles, hotels, parks
# and cinemas, Liga BetPlay football clubs.
# Sources: English Wikipedia "List of companies of Colombia"; Spanish Wikipedia "Categoría:Empresas de Colombia" and
# subcategories (por sector, alimentación, medios de comunicación, transporte, telecomunicaciones, centros comerciales,
# restaurantes, bebidas alcohólicas, cervezas, cotizadas en la Bolsa de Valores de Colombia), "Categoría:Marcas
# colombianas"; Brandvalorum "Marcas colombianas más valiosas" (via Forbes Colombia); Valora Analitik startup-brand
# ranking; press articles on Colombian swimwear labels (La República, Portafolio); own knowledge for the rest
# (brand portfolios of Nutresa, Quala, Colombina, Tecnoquímicas, Postobón, Alpina, radio/TV networks, designers).
# Hangul: established Korean spellings where they exist (후안 발데스, 아비앙카, 방콜롬비아, 에코페트롤 ...);
# otherwise 스페인어 외래어 표기법; Spanish initialisms read with Spanish letter names (EPM 에페에메).
